stories.title: Fan called for interference in Bronx as Yankees lose out on tying, 2-run HR
stories.summary: Fan interference was called in the sixth inning of Wednesday night's ALDS Game 3 at Yankee Stadium, denying the Yankees of a potential game-tying home run before they were swept by the Rays with a 4-3 loss.

stories.title: No. 9 hitter Pages delivers in clutch, sends Dodgers to 3rd straight NLCS
stories.summary: For all the stars the Dodgers boast, it was No. 9 hitter Andy Pages who came through with the big hit, sending Los Angeles to a 4-1 win over the Braves that clinched its third straight NLCS appearance.

stories.title: NBA, FIBA say Europe push to continue without EuroLeague
stories.summary: The NBA and FIBA say they are undeterred in moving forward with the NBA Europe plan after EuroLeague's team owners rejected a merger offer this week.

stories.title: Stewart says Liberty told they did not have reset timeout in OT; refs dispute this
stories.summary: Breanna Stewart said officials told her the Liberty did not have a reset timeout to use at the end of overtime in Wednesday's loss at Atlanta. Crew chief Fatou Cissoko-Stephens disputed this in a pool report, saying the remaining timeout was communicated.

stories.title: Mitchell's late HR robbery helps seal win, as Brewers set rematch with L.A.
stories.summary: Garrett Mitchell robbed the Padres' Manny Machado of a potential game-tying home run in the eighth inning, and the Brewers advanced to the NLCS for the second straight season with a 3-1 win in Game 4.
